newsitem.title: USA: Kenwin Shops AMEX delisting appeal denied.
newsitem.headline: Kenwin Shops AMEX delisting appeal denied.

text.p: Kenwin Shops Inc said on Friday that its appeal of the American Stock Exchange decision to delist its common stock has been denied.
The company said the last day of trading on the exchange will be December 27, 1996.

Kenwin said it has initiated discussions with firms expressing an interest in making a market for its common stock and that it expects the stock to continue trading over the counter following removal from the AMEX.
